{
  "name": "litclaude",
  "description": "Claude Code-native workflow plugin with a bounded-authority start-work lifecycle.",
  "version": "1.0.34",
  "author": {
    "name": "LitClaude contributors"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/wjgoarxiv/litclaude",
  "repository": "https://github.com/wjgoarxiv/litclaude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "hooks",
    "skills",
    "agents",
    "lsp",
    "workflow",
    "start-work-lifecycle"
  ],
  "skills": "./skills",
  "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json",
  "lspServers": "./.lsp.json",
  "displayName": "LitClaude",
  "defaultEnabled": true,
  "userConfig": {
    "motion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "LIT band motion",
      "description": "How the band above the prompt moves: full (during work the LIT pill breathes, a light sweeps the phase and a comet runs the border), subtle (only the breathing) or off.",
      "default": "full"
    },
    "glyphs": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "LIT band glyphs",
      "description": "auto uses the icon font when it is installed (litclaude-ai install --icon-font); nerd always; basic works with any font.",
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "LIT band",
      "description": "When the LIT card shows above the prompt: always (the whole session, idle included), auto (only while LitClaude work is active or a skill of this request is lit) or off.",
      "default": "always"
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "LIT finish notification",
      "description": "off, or finish: a notification through your own notification channel when LIT work completes or a LIT turn longer than three minutes ends. finish+sound also plays a sound once LitClaude ships one; until then it notifies like finish.",
      "default": "off"
    }
  }
}
